startInstructions.message:
[STEP 1] Load Extension in Chrome (one time):
  1. Open Chrome: chrome://extensions/
  2. Enable Developer mode (top-right toggle)
  3. Click 'Load unpacked'
  4. Select folder: $extensionPath$
  Note: Keep this folder loaded; the WXT dev server writes to the same path.

[STEP 2] Connect the MCP Service:
  1. Click the extension icon in Chrome
  2. Click the Connect button
  3. The service will start at http://127.0.0.1:12306

[STEP 3] Dynamic Debugging (by component):

  POPUP (apps/chrome-extension/entrypoints/popup/):
    - Right-click the popup -> Inspect -> DevTools opens
    - After saving a file, reopen the popup (WXT HMR reloads it automatically)
    - Or press Ctrl+R in DevTools to force a refresh

  BACKGROUND SERVICE WORKER (entrypoints/background.ts):
    - Go to chrome://extensions/ -> find the extension -> click 'Service Worker'
    - After saving a file, click the circular refresh icon on the extension card
    - WXT reloads the extension automatically after a rebuild

  CONTENT SCRIPTS (entrypoints/content.ts / inject-scripts/):
    - Open the target page -> F12 -> Sources -> Content Scripts tab
    - After saving a file, refresh the target page (Ctrl+R)
    - WXT dynamically re-registers content scripts in development mode

  INSPECT ALL EXTENSION PAGES:
    - Open chrome://inspect/#extensions
